topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture by framing the session around histopathology observations and outlining the key learning outcomes.

topics.label: Tumor Virology and Assays for Cellular Transformation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace how the study of tumor viruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and led to experimental assays for assessing cellular transformation.

topics.label: Classification, Cell Cycle Regulation, and Mutational Mechanics of Cancer Genes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the definitions, cellular regulatory pathways, and distinct mutational mechanisms that distinguish oncogenes from tumor suppressor genes.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Forms of Genetic Instability in Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the different types of genetic instability resulting from failures in DNA repair pathways, replication fidelity, and mitotic chromosome segregation.

topics.label: Multistep Tumor Progression and Hereditary Cancer Predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address how sequential mutational accumulation drives cancer progression and how inherited germline mutations accelerate this trajectory.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Recommended Reading
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture with a summary review, recommended reading, and a look ahead to the next session.
